Name: Michah, Son of Uzziel
Summary: First son of Uzziel in David's divisions.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 23:20; 1 Chronicles 24:24: First son of Uzziel in David's divisions.
LifeLesson: The mention of Michah in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
